description:
Parent epic JMAP-lbdy acceptance criterion: 'Every migrated crate's PLAN.md notes the policy in the type-design section.'

After JMAP-lbdy.9 migrated 29 wire-format structs across 6 client crates (jmap-base-client, jmap-mail-client, jmap-chat-client, jmap-calendars-client, jmap-contacts-client, jmap-filenode-client), the client-crate PLAN.md files were not updated to document the extras policy. Type crates' PLAN.md files (jmap-mail-types, jmap-chat-types, etc.) already contain such notes per JMAP-lbdy.2-.8.

In scope:
- crate-jmap-base-client/PLAN.md
- crate-jmap-mail-client/PLAN.md
- crate-jmap-chat-client/PLAN.md
- crate-jmap-calendars-client/PLAN.md
- crate-jmap-contacts-client/PLAN.md
- crate-jmap-filenode-client/PLAN.md
- crate-jmap-sharing-client/PLAN.md (no in-scope structs; note this)
- crate-jmap-tasks-client/PLAN.md (no in-scope structs; note this)

Mirror the canonical pattern from crate-jmap-mail-types/PLAN.md (search for 'extras-preservation' there for the exact wording). Each note should:
1. Quote the policy attribute set
2. Enumerate the in-scope structs in that crate (or note 'none — only re-exports from jmap-*-types' for sharing-client / tasks-client)
3. Reference workspace AGENTS.md for the full policy text

Acceptance: each of the 8 client-crate PLAN.md files contains an extras-preservation section. No code changes required.
title: Add extras policy notes to *-client crate PLAN.md files (JMAP-lbdy follow-up)
